title: ALMA Observations of HCO<SUP>+</SUP> and HCN Emission in the Massive Star-forming Region N55 of the Large Magellanic Cloud
question: How do the properties of dense molecular clumps (size, linewidth, mass, dense gas fraction) relate to star formation in the quiescent N 55-S region of the LMC, compared with other LMC GMCs

data.sensitivity: rms ~10 mJy/beam (HCO+) and 11 mJy/beam (HCN) per 0.4 km/s channel

what.value: 12CO(1-0) and 13CO(1-0) maps of N 55-S, used for comparison and for the CO-traced H2 mass

evidence.loc: HCO and HCN emission in N 55
evidence.quote: The $^{12}$CO($1-0$) and $^{13}$CO($1-0$) maps of N 55-S (cite: naslim2018) is also shown for a comparison

what.value: 12CO(1-0) excitation temperature 20 to 40 K, basis for assumed Tex = 30 K

evidence.quote: Their study shows that $T_{\rm ex}$ values of $^{12}$CO ($1-0$) range from 20 to 40 K in the N 55-S.

what.value: 30% missing flux in the ALMA 12CO(1-0) maps, applied to the CO-traced H2 mass

evidence.quote: (cite: naslim2018) report a 30% missing flux in the ALMA $^{12}$CO(1-0) emission maps.
Assuming the relative abundance of HCO$^{+}$ to H$_{2}$ to be X=10$^{-9}$

what.value: HCO+(1-0) partition function 14.4 at Tex = 30 K

evidence.quote: The partition function $Q_{rot}$ of HCO$^{+}$($1-0$) transition is 14.4 at $T_{\rm ex}=30$ K (cite: rohlfs2004; mangum2015).

what.value: YSO positions and 8 micron magnitudes in N 55-S

evidence.quote: The 8$\mu$m magnitudes of the YSOs associated with clumps 2, 3, 7, and 8 in the N 55-S are $\sim$ \[8.24\], \[7.27\], \[10.19\] and \[8.76\] respectively (cite: gruendl2009).

external_data.citation: Gruendl & Chu 2009 (cite: gruendl2009); Chen et al. 2009 (cite: chen2009)

what.value: Dense gas fraction of other LMC GMCs 0.1-0.24; HCN/HCO+ flux ratio 0.1-0.5 for LMC clouds and ~0.2 for 30 Doradus-10, used for comparison

evidence.loc: Comparison of N 55 clump properties with other LMC clouds
evidence.quote: The dense gas fraction of N 55-S is 0.025$\pm$0.005, smaller than the fraction seen in other GMCs; 0.1$-$0.24.

evidence.loc: Comparison of N 55 clump properties with other LMC clouds
evidence.quote: The HCN/HCO$^{+}$ flux ratio is found to be (0.1$-$0.5) for various LMC clouds (N 105, N 113, N 159, and N 44) by (cite: seale2012)

external_data.citation: Seale et al. 2012 (cite: seale2012); Anderson et al. 2014 (cite: anderson2014)

recipe.method: ALMA pipeline calibrated visibilities imaged with CASA tclean at 0.4 km/s channels, Briggs weighting
Integrate HCO+ and HCN cubes along the velocity axis

recipe.goal: Identify clumps and measure size, linewidth and flux
recipe.method: astrodendro dendrogram on the data cubes; leaves taken as clumps; parameters by bisection method
assumptions: Gaussian line profiles for FWHM from sigma_v

recipe.goal: Derive HCO+ and H2 column density and optical depth
recipe.method: LTE analysis with peak optical depth from peak brightness temperature, then N_H2 from assumed HCO+ abundance

recipe.goal: Derive volume density, surface density, LTE and virial masses and virial parameter
recipe.method: n_col, Sigma_p, M_LTE, M_vir equations; virial parameter alpha = M_vir/M_LTE
assumptions: Spherical clumps with radial power-law density profile

recipe.method: CO-traced H2 mass (L_CO, X_CO, 30% missing-flux correction) compared with HCO+ mass sum
assumptions: Galactic X_CO is adequate for metallicities down to ~0.5 Zsun

recipe.goal: Fit size-linewidth relation and test virial state
recipe.method: Power-law fit of linewidth versus radius for HCO+ clumps; virial parameter examined

recipe.goal: Associate clumps with YSOs and compare with other LMC clouds
recipe.method: Positional match of Spitzer YSOs to emission peaks; clumps with and without YSOs compared in mass, surface density and linewidth; comparison with Seale et al. 2012 and Anderson et al. 2014 clumps
assumptions: 8 micron magnitude used as proxy for YSO mass

evidence.quote: We identify 10 significant molecular clumps in the HCO$^{+}$(1$-$0) and 8 in the HCN(1$-$0) data cubes.

Thus the dense gas fraction in the N 55-S region is 0.025$\pm$0.005.

answer_key.quantity: Mass surface density threshold for YSO association

evidence.quote: The clumps with mass-surface densities $\geq$ 73 $M_{\odot}$ pc$^{-2}$ shows YSO association in N 55-S.

answer_key.quantity: FWHM linewidths of YSO-associated clumps vs clumps without YSOs
